# Agent tools and token usage

Every action an agent can take is a **tool**: a Python function behind a JSON schema, defined in `strategy/agents/*_agent.py`. Agents can't touch files, the network or other agents' data except through these 21 tools. This page lists each one, what it does, the rules it enforces, and **exactly how many tokens it costs**.

![Agent tools vs tokens](images/tool-tokens.png)

*The chart is generated by `evals/token_chart.py` from `evals/token_profile.py`. Both panels use exact counts from the token-counting endpoint. Re-generate them for any run:*

```powershell
.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m evals.token_profile runs\<id> --markdown docs\token-usage.md   # exact counts (free API endpoint)
$env:MPLCONFIGDIR=".cache\matplotlib"; .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m evals.token_chart runs\<id> docs\images\tool-tokens.png
```

## How tool tokens are counted

A tool costs tokens in two ways:

| Cost | When it's paid | How it's measured |
|---|---|---|
| **Definition tokens** | The tool's name, description and JSON schema are sent with **every model call** of that agent. After the first call they're served from the prompt cache at about 1/20 of the input price. | Marginal count: tokens with all of the agent's tools, minus tokens with this one removed |
| **Result tokens** | The text a call returns is sent back to the model once, then **stays in that agent's context** for all its remaining turns (cached after the first). | The exact returned text, logged in `trace.jsonl` as `result`, counted as a message, minus the empty-message baseline |
| **Tool-use overhead** | A fixed block the API adds whenever tools are enabled (about 286 tokens), regardless of how many there are | Tokens with all tools, minus tokens with none, minus the sum of the marginals |

Model calls are also billed for **output** (what the agent writes, including thinking) and for **system prompts**. Both are in the per-agent table at the end.

## Tool catalog and measured tokens

Measured on live run `20261019-224835` (momentum v3).

### Data Agent (effort: low)

| Tool | What it does | Rules enforced in code | Definition tokens | Calls | Result tokens (mean / total) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fetch_prices(tickers, start)` | Downloads adjusted daily closes from Yahoo Finance (or the project cache offline) | **Ticker allowlist** (SPY, QQQ, TLT, GLD, IWM, IEF, ^IRX), date range 1990 to today, yfinance cache confined to the project | 243 | 1 | 262 / 262 |
| `check_data_quality()` | Reports missing values (after each ticker's inception), calendar gaps, moves over 25%, stale runs, and the T-bill range | Must run after a fetch | 92 | 1 | 456 / 456 |
| `save_dataset()` | Cleans the data: keeps days when both ETFs traded, drops **today's incomplete session**, forward-fills the T-bill rate. Writes `prices.csv` and `data_report.json`. | Requires the quality check first. At least 10 years of data. | 83 | 1 | 60 / 60 |

### Backtest Agent (effort: low)

| Tool | What it does | Rules | Definition tokens | Calls | Result tokens (mean / total) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `run_ma_backtest(ma_days)` | Full-period stats for one MA switching rule (5/20/50/200), labeled **IN-SAMPLE** | `ma_days` limited to the 4 candidates | 122 | 4 | 210 / 838 |
| `run_walk_forward(min_train_years)` | The official MA strategy: each January it picks the best prior-Sharpe MA, using only earlier data | `min_train_years` fixed by config | 104 | 1 | 194 / 194 |
| `compare_candidates()` | In-sample table of all 4 MAs over the walk-forward period | Requires the walk-forward first (the most common self-correction) | 82 | 2 (1 err) | 342 / 684 |
| `run_momentum(lookback_months)` | One momentum sub-strategy: 50/30/20 in the top three, always invested | Lookback limited to 1/3/6/12/24. Every rule parameter passed from config. | 200 | 5 | 480 / 2,402 |
| `save_backtest(methodology_summary)` | Writes `backtest.json`, `momentum.json` and `returns.csv` (daily returns and weights) | Requires all 4 MAs, the walk-forward, the comparison and all 5 lookbacks | 112 | 1 | 36 / 36 |

### Analytics Agent (effort: medium)

| Tool | What it does | Rules | Definition tokens | Calls | Result tokens (mean / total) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `compute_metrics(window)` | MA strategy vs SPY vs 60/40 for 3M/1Y/3Y/5Y/SI: returns, volatility, Sharpe, Sortino, max drawdown, Calmar, beta, correlation, capture ratios, hit rate, switching | Window enum. Display-rounded output. | 181 | 5 | 638 / 3,191 |
| `rolling_analysis()` | Rolling 1-year comparison vs SPY, growth of $10,000, calendar years | none | 94 | 1 | 1,008 / 1,008 |
| `compute_comparison(window)` | **Head to head** over the common period: 5 momentum lookbacks, MA, SPY and QQQ, plus momentum activity. The "since 2011" call also returns calendar years, growth and cost sensitivity. | Window enum. Momentum must exist. | 215 | 5 | 2,238 / **11,188** |
| `save_analytics(findings)` | Saves 5–9 findings | **Every number is checked against the results.** At least 2 findings on momentum and 1 vs QQQ. All windows computed first. | 141 | 1 | 19 / 19 |

### Team Agent (effort: low)

| Tool | What it does | Rules | Definition tokens | Calls | Result tokens (mean / total) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `submit_team(members)` | Validates and saves the 6 fictional personas | Pydantic schema: 1 PM + 5 analysts, certification allowlist, **fictional employers** (word-boundary match against real firms), no famous names, experience consistent with career dates, compliant bio language | **836** (the largest: a full nested schema) | 1 | 182 / 182 |

### Presentation Agent (effort: medium)

| Tool | What it does | Rules | Definition tokens | Calls | Result tokens (mean / total) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `list_metrics()` | Every figure the agent may cite: **exactly the fields the PDF tables print** (traceability by construction) | none | 72 | 1 | **8,793** (the largest single result) |
| `get_team()` | Names, titles and focuses of the personas | Team must exist | 75 | 1 | 376 / 376 |
| `render_chart(kind)` | Renders one of 11 chart kinds to PNG | Kind enum. Matplotlib cache must be inside the project. | 184 | 10 | 16 / 157 |
| `add_slide(title, bullets, chart)` | Appends a slide | **Number faithfulness, banned language, persona names**, length limits, chart rendered first | 231 | 20 (1 err) | 47 / 948 |
| `revise_slide(existing_title, title, bullets, chart)` | Replaces a slide in place, with the same checks | Same as `add_slide` | 264 | 4 (1 err) | 64 / 254 |
| `add_standard_page(page)` | Inserts a code-generated page: metrics table, in-sample table, comparison, momentum detail or team | Page enum, once each | 130 | 5 | 17 / 86 |
| `build_pdf()` | Builds the deck | 11–22 slides, required charts and pages, **Pro/Con slide per lookback, comparison slide, Executive Summary verdict, balance acknowledgements, no cash language and no defensive claims for momentum (v3)** | 76 | 1 | 20 / 20 |

## Per-agent token use (same run)

| Agent | Effort | System prompt | All tool definitions | Model turns | Uncached input | Cache write | Cache read | Output | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Data | low | 408 | 704 | 4 | 10 | 2,298 | 4,681 | 1,231 | $0.037 |
| Backtest | low | 699 | 906 | 4 | 10 | 6,960 | 14,212 | 2,108 | $0.080 |
| Analytics | medium | 667 | 917 | 3 | 8 | 20,068 | 19,519 | 3,709 | $0.178 |
| Team | low | 608 | 836 | 2 | 6 | 4,431 | 1,476 | 2,745 | $0.077 |
| Presentation | medium | 2,557 | 1,318 | 14 | 30 | 35,210 | **333,703** | 20,143 | $0.646 |

## What the numbers say

- **Results, not definitions, drive cost.** Definitions total about 4,700 tokens across all agents, and they're cached after the first call. Results such as `compute_comparison` (11,188) and `list_metrics` (8,793) enter a context that is re-sent on every later turn.
- **The Presentation Agent is about 2/3 of the cost.** Its 8,793-token `list_metrics` result sits in context for its next 13 turns, so cache reads alone are about 334K tokens. Caching makes this cheap: the run's 334K cached tokens cost about $0.07.
- **Prompt caching does most of the work.** Uncached input is only about 64 tokens across all 27 model calls. Everything else is cache writes and reads.
- **Possible optimizations,** not applied, because the cost is already about $1 per run:
  - split `list_metrics` into narrower calls
  - trim `compute_comparison` output to the fields the analytics findings use
  - drop `submit_team`'s descriptive schema text, which is 836 definition tokens
